biw_news.title: Mahindra Thar Roxx Integrates Advanced DaVinci Suspension Architecture
biw_news.summary: Recent spy shots highlight comprehensive chassis updates, confirming the integration of the sophisticated DaVinci suspension system designed to optimize dynamic handling and load distribution across rigid axle architecture.

biw_news.title: Lamborghini Urus Performante Adopts Advanced 6D Active Suspension and Chassis Sensors
biw_news.summary: The high-performance SUV features state-of-the-art active air suspension tied with multi-axis 6D sensor technology, delivering superior real-time body control and structural response under extreme cornering loads.

biw_news.title: Volkswagen Unveils ID. Tiguan EV Built on Dedicated Electric Skateboard Platform
biw_news.summary: The newly debuted electric SUV leverages a high-voltage battery skateboard chassis architecture, optimizing torsional rigidity and lower-center-of-gravity crash safety performance across its structural envelope.

biw_news.title: Jaguar Rebirth Signals Monocoque Re-Engineering With Type 01 Flagship EV
biw_news.summary: Jaguar's latest ultra-high-output electric platform showcases an entirely bespoke aluminum-intensive architecture designed to manage massive torque loads while maintaining strict weight-reduction targets for enhanced crashworthiness.

biw_news.title: BMW Expands Neue Klasse EV Architecture With Dynamic iX4 Crossover
biw_news.summary: Utilizing BMW's modular Neue Klasse structural foundation, the iX4 incorporates advanced battery pack structural integration and lightweight multi-material chassis engineering to balance aerodynamic efficiency with frame rigidity.

biw_news.title: Bentley Torcal Enters Luxury EV Sector With High-Rigidity Dedicated Chassis
biw_news.summary: Bentley's maiden battery-electric vehicle introduces a heavily reinforced subframe and structural battery enclosure designed to safely contain massive power outputs while ensuring optimal passenger compartment intrusion protection.
